fact: In June 2025 the National Identification Registry sought to contract Austrian firm OSD International to pre-finance a biometric ID project estimated at US$9.85 million at no cost to government, which the procurement regulator PPCC ruled a public-private partnership or concession needing open international bidding on 7 July 2025.
title: Boakai's $44M Biometric ID Controversy: Who Briefed the President Before PPCC's Rejection?
